newsitem.title: USA: United Natural sets Stow Mills acquisition.
newsitem.headline: United Natural sets Stow Mills acquisition.

text.p: United Natural Foods Inc said Monday it agreed to acquire Stow Mills Inc in exchange for five million common shares, placing a value of about $91,250,000 on the transaction, which has been approved by directors of both companies.
On a combined basis, the two leading natural products companies will distribute in 46 states, including the Mid-West.
United Natural Foods said the transaction value is based on its June 2O closing stock price of $18.25 per share.
For the year ended December 31, 1996, Stow Mills achieved sales of $208 million. Stow Mills' sales and operating income have increased in each of the last three fiscal years.
Norman Cloutier will continue as chairman and chief executive officer of United Natural Foods.
Richard Youngman, president of Stow Mills, will continue to operate Stow Mills on a day-to-day basis and report directly to Cloutier.
Both Youngman and Stow Mills chief executive Barclay McFadden will be nominated to serve as directors of United Natural Foods. ((-- New York Newsdesk 212 859-1610))
